title: Lanterns of the Ledger Line
setting_summary: A vertical arcology called the Ledger Line runs on rationed daylight and a strict merit-point economy, where every resident's worth is recalculated each dawn by an unseen auditing authority. When a clerical error erases an entire floor's points, a small crew of auditors and couriers must decide whether to correct the math or expose the system that made them complicit. Each chapter hears a different resident's case, turning the arcology into a courtroom of songs where dignity, voice, and survival are weighed against the ledger.
